title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.1
subtitle: Pull to detach physics while keeping baked playback.

highlights.title: Pull to Detach
highlights.description: Hold the floating Cloth NeXt logo and pull left until armed. Release to remove physics from the eligible selection captured when you pressed.

highlights.title: Deliberate and cancellable
highlights.description: Pull back, press Escape or right-click to cancel. Active Bake blocks the gesture. The toolbar stays unchanged when idle.

highlights.title: Baked playback stays
highlights.description: Detach resets only Cloth NeXt physics settings. Mesh Cache modifiers, baked PC2 files and other object data remain intact.
